Frontend Playwright (1920x1080 + 390x844): owner /pengaturan shows exactly {Toko & perangkat, Pengguna, Akun} (no Tenant); Toko Pilot card + dev-pilot-01 + cam-door-front visible; owner creates store 'TEST_UI_Store_*' via manage-store-add, device 'edge-qa-*' via manage-device-add reveals device-api-key starting 'dk_' + key-reveal-done; creates camera 'cam-qa-*' via camera-external-id-input+camera-device-select. Account tab shows account-email + account-roles. nav-manage-link visible in rail. Horizontal overflow = 0 at both 1920 and 390. All page.on('dialog') accepted for confirm prompts (none surfaced in this flow).

issues: HTML5 pattern attribute '[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' is invalid under the v-flag (Chrome 124+/Safari 17.4+): console SyntaxError 'Invalid character in character class'. Client-side pattern validation is skipped; backend 422 still guards but the browser-level UX check is dead. Fix: escape the dot/dash — pattern="[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+" or [A-Za-z0-9_\.-]+.

action_items: Escape the '.' or '-' in CameraDialog.tsx pattern attribute for external_id-input so it is a valid RegExp under the v-flag (currently logs a SyntaxError in modern browsers).
critical_code_review_comments: Role-based access is enforced consistently in manage.py (`require_platform_admin` for /tenants POST + /users; `require_user` + `can_manage(tenant_id)` for owner-only writes; `_visible_*` returns 404 for cross-tenant reads — correct 404-vs-403 split per contract).

Device key rotation correctly overwrites key_id/secret_hash/api_key_prefix and old token immediately 401s (verified). `is_active=false` returns 403 (not 401), matching contract for 'known device, currently disabled'.
Camera device_id cross-store guard is enforced with 422 + message 'device_id must belong to the same store' — good defensive check on both POST and PATCH.
Own-role change/removal correctly returns 409 (not 403) — sensible; prevents accidental self-lockout.
Admin PATCH /users/{id} is_active=false invalidates JWT via user.is_active check on next request (401). No token revocation table needed; deactivate flag alone works.
MembersPanel window.confirm for delete/remove is accepted via page.on('dialog') — not a bug, just a Playwright gotcha for future testers.
Test file must be run SERIALLY (module-level _STATE threads UUIDs). Header comment updated to specify `-o addopts=""` to override the project's default -n auto/--dist loadscope.
Prior iteration_5 note about Toolbar chevron touch target (36px vs 44px WCAG target) still applies; unrelated to Phase 1.

rca of the issue: CameraDialog external_id pattern: pattern="[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+" is compiled by the browser under the RegExp v-flag (per HTML spec since 2024). Under v-flag, '.-' inside a character class is a reserved range operator and must be escaped or ordered differently. Chrome/Safari log SyntaxError and skip the client-side check. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/manage/CameraDialog.tsx line 32: change pattern to "[A-Za-z0-9_.\\-]+" (escape the dash) or place the dash first/last: "[-A-Za-z0-9_.]+". Backend accepts/rejects correctly regardless (422 for space).
